summary: R. S. Michael, Airport Director for Milwaukee County, testified at the March 25, 1969 Corridor Location Public Hearing in support of the Airport Spur project. He expressed support for the concept of direct limited freeway access from I-94 to the General Mitchell Field terminal area and provided specific reasons for his endorsement. No response from the agency was deemed necessary.
